projectDescription: Deploy the OpenClaw personal AI assistant on Cloudflare's serverless infrastructure, with multi-channel chat support, device pairing authentication, browser automation, and optional persistent storage — no self-hosting required.
keyFeatures: One-click deploy to Cloudflare Workers with no server management
Web-based Control UI with real-time WebSocket chat
Multi-channel support: Telegram, Discord, and Slack
Device pairing authentication with explicit per-device approval
Persistent storage via Cloudflare R2 across container restarts
Browser automation with Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP) shim
Cloudflare AI Gateway integration for caching, analytics, and rate limiting
Admin UI for device management, R2 backup status, and gateway control
Configurable container sleep for cost optimization
Support for Anthropic, OpenAI, Workers AI, and Groq via AI Gateway
publicApiSurface: GET /debug/logs?id=<process_id> — get logs for a process
GET /debug/version — container and OpenClaw version info
GET /cdp/json/new — create a new browser target
/_admin/ — Admin UI for device and storage management
MOLTBOT_GATEWAY_TOKEN secret — token for Control UI access
SANDBOX_SLEEP_AFTER secret — container idle sleep duration
ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY — direct AI provider keys
